reviews.title: Works well, fantastic price.
reviews.comment: I was pleasantly surprised.  I upgraded to this from my aging Cooler Master ML360R and this actually improved my temperatures by 3C, despite the fact that the Cooler Master AIO cost over 3 times more.
reviews.author: Chris Brown

reviews.title: Amazing Value
reviews.comment: Super easy to set up, just install the brackets for your socket and screw the pump block to it. The fans were very silent, a clear clone of the Noctua NHA12x25. Pump was very quiet as well and kept my 7600X cool. However, I decided to go with air cooling instead due to reliability from a long term standpoint.
reviews.author: Cuong Tu

reviews.title: Great addition to PC, been running strong with cooling
reviews.comment: Great buy for the white pc build. Loved the rgb on the heat sink and liked that I didn't need to spend time setting up the water or other parts. Great addition but needs better instructions on installation. Took some time to understand that the water was already added.
reviews.author: Oscar

reviews.title: Just as good as big brand names...
reviews.comment: Keeps my Ryzen 7 5800xt nice and cool under heavy loads or just at idle. Very easy to install, fits perfectly in my matx case.
reviews.author: Chris

reviews.title: Affordable and Quality! (slightly loud pump)
reviews.comment: Had a corsair h60 120MM AIO that either was dead or struggling as my i7 9700k would get to 85-90C and BSOD or just struggle. Replaced with this cooler and I'm now at 60C under load which is fantastic! The fans and pump are a little noisy, but I wear a headset when it's under load so I don't hear it and for 55$ you really can't go wrong, do be careful when you order that you get the right socket size, I almost made that mistake but caught it last second before ordering. The RGB cable is too short but for some reason as my motherboard has the pin out at the bottom so not sure if I can blame the AIO or motherboard design for that one, Ill either leave it unplugged or get an extender if I really want to see the pretty lights. I really didn't want to spend 100$ + on a new cooler for this PC so I'm extremely happy with this purchase! Would recommend for those on a budget. Not sure longevity as I have only had it for 1 month.
reviews.author: Traci D.
